components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Directory Search
components.description: Search field inside a lilac filter bar.
components.css: .ds-search { display: grid; gap: .25rem; padding: .75rem; color: var(--ink, #1c1634); background: var(--docket, #e5e0ff); font: 700 1rem/1.55 var(--font-sans, 'Source Sans 3', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); } .ds-search__field { position: relative; display: flex; min-width: 0; } .ds-search svg { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: .75rem; width: 1.15rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; transform: translateY(-50%); pointer-events: none; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; min-height: 2.875rem; padding: .625rem .75rem .625rem 2.35rem; color: var(--ink, #1c1634); background: var(--sheet, #fffefd); border: 1px solid var(--muted, #595170); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, .25rem); font: 400 1rem/1.55 var(--font-sans, 'Source Sans 3', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #595170); } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: .16rem solid var(--indigo-700, #3d2ac4); outline-offset: .22rem; box-shadow: 0 0 0 .22rem var(--sheet, #fffefd); }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Sheet header links with a visible current route.

components.css: .ds-navigation { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; min-height: 4.5rem; padding: .45rem 1rem; color: var(--ink, #1c1634); background: var(--sheet, #fffefd); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #d9d4ef); font: 600 1rem/1.55 var(--font-sans, 'Source Sans 3', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); } .ds-navigation a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: .21em; } .ds-navigation a:is(:hover, [aria-current]) { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-navigation a[aria-current] { color: var(--indigo-700, #3d2ac4); } .ds-navigation a:focus-visible { outline: .16rem solid var(--indigo-700, #3d2ac4); outline-offset: .22rem; box-shadow: 0 0 0 .22rem var(--sheet, #fffefd); }

components.name: Exchange Manifest
components.description: A ruled document row with visible exchange direction and status.
components.css: .ds-manifest { margin: 0; color: var(--ink, #1c1634); background: var(--sheet, #fffefd); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d9d4ef); border-radius: var(--radius-md, .5rem); overflow: clip; font: 400 1rem/1.55 var(--font-sans, 'Source Sans 3', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); } .ds-manifest header { padding: 1.15rem .9rem; color: var(--sheet, #fffefd); background: var(--electric, #4228d1); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #d9d4ef); font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-manifest__row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .4rem 1rem; min-height: 4.3rem; padding: .65rem .9rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #d9d4ef); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-manifest__row span, .ds-manifest figcaption { color: var(--muted, #595170); font-size: .94rem; } .ds-manifest__status { display: flex; gap: .4rem; align-items: center; color: var(--mint-deep, #1c5b38); } .ds-manifest__status::before { width: .44rem; height: .44rem; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; content: ""; } .ds-manifest figcaption { padding: .65rem .9rem; } .ds-manifest__columns { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; gap: .5rem; padding: .5rem .9rem; color: var(--indigo-900, #291c91); background: var(--docket, #e5e0ff); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #d9d4ef); font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-manifest__route { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; min-width: 6rem; color: var(--indigo-700, #3d2ac4); } .ds-manifest__direction { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-manifest__route::before { position: absolute; inset-inline: .3rem; height: 1px; background: currentColor; content: ""; } .ds-manifest__route::after { position: absolute; inset-inline-start: .42rem; width: .4rem; height: .4rem; border: solid currentColor; border-width: 1px 1px 0 0; content: ""; transform: rotate(-135deg); } .ds-manifest__route svg { z-index: 1; width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; padding: .23rem; background: var(--mint, #a4f5bc); border-radius: 50%; } @media (max-width: 50rem) { .ds-manifest__columns, .ds-manifest__route::before, .ds-manifest__route::after, .ds-manifest__route svg { display: none; } .ds-manifest__direction { position: static; width: auto; height: auto; clip-path: none; white-space: normal; } }

components.name: Guide Index Row
components.description: A single navigation target for the guide title and summary.
components.html: How EDI costs workUnderstand the mailbox fee and count business documents.
components.css: .ds-guide { border-block: 1px solid var(--rule, #d9d4ef); border-top: 2px solid var(--indigo-950, #1d146c); font: 400 1rem/1.55 var(--font-sans, 'Source Sans 3', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); } .ds-guide a { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: .7rem 2rem; padding: 1.25rem 0; color: var(--indigo-950, #1d146c); text-decoration: none; } .ds-guide a::after { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / 3; width: .7rem; height: .7rem; border-top: 2px solid; border-right: 2px solid; transform: rotate(45deg); content: ""; } .ds-guide strong { font-size: 1.55rem; line-height: 1.12; } .ds-guide span { grid-row: 2; color: var(--muted, #595170); font-size: 1.1rem; } .ds-guide a:is(:hover, :focus-visible) strong { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: .17em; } .ds-guide a:focus-visible { outline: .16rem solid var(--indigo-700, #3d2ac4); outline-offset: .22rem; box-shadow: 0 0 0 .22rem var(--sheet, #fffefd); }

narrative.overview: The visual system borrows the clarity of shipping paperwork. Indigo and electric violet give the exchange a strong visual identity. Pale lilac, ruled columns and explicit labels make document flows, rates and catalogues easy to scan. Reading pages use a pale masthead and a section index.
keyCharacteristics: Deep indigo mastheads and pale lilac reading surfaces
Electric violet exchange headings and lilac tool strips
Strong Source Sans 3 headings and readable prose
Flat, ruled lists and document sheets with compact corners
Luminous mint actions and exchange marks, with labelled green success states

rules.name: The Signal Color Rule
rules.body: Use mint for action, selection and the exchange marker. Pair successful status color with a visible label.

rules.name: The Numeral Alignment Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for prices and comparable counts.

dos: Do Put the primary action and strongest evidence early in the page.
Do Keep pricing and example values identifiable and easy to compare.
Do Use semantic headings, persistent labels, visible focus and readable contrast.
donts: Don't Imply a live retailer connection through an illustration or directory listing.
Don't Use neon gradients, glass effects or decorative technology imagery.
Don't Add visual ornament that competes with document names, prices and statuses.
